attributes.description: Kibana Task Manager health, configuration, runtime, capacity estimation, workload, and task type metrics from Kibana diagnostics

params.markdown:
### Workload
Workload is cluster-wide, so every Kibana node reports the same values. Tiles show the maximum, never a sum across nodes.

### Capacity estimation
Reported by Kibana 7.16 and later. Compare observed Kibana instances with the proposed number, and maximum throughput with required throughput.
